description: Source code for vendor plugin handling in a device management system, including functions for overwriting parameters and objects, loading vendor extensions, and excluding objects/parameters based on vendor list.

methods.name: overwrite_param
methods.description: Overwrites the parameter values in an entry object with values from a leaf if parameters match.

methods.name: overwrite_obj
methods.description: Overwrites object properties in an entry object with those from another object if object names match.

methods.name: load_vendor_extension_arrays
methods.description: Loads vendor-specific extension arrays into the entry object based on vendor list.

methods.name: load_vendor_extension_overwrite_arrays
methods.description: Loads vendor-specific overwrite arrays into the entry object based on vendor list.

methods.name: exclude_obj
methods.description: Excludes an object from the entry object based on object path.

methods.name: exclude_param
methods.description: Excludes a parameter from the entry object based on parameter path.

methods.name: load_vendor_extension_exclude_arrays
methods.description: Loads vendor-specific exclude arrays into the entry object based on vendor list.

methods.name: load_vendor_dynamic_arrays
methods.description: Main function to load all vendor extension arrays, overwrite arrays, and exclude arrays into the entry object.
